phase_name: CI honesty: flush the stale PR queue
note: Phase 8 ship 3 of the serial ladder: PR #136, the CI-honesty branch, rebased off a 34-commit-stale base onto current main. It arrived declaring PHASE 6 because main still carries Phase 6's arc-state -- the P8 write lives on the #183/#184 branch and has not merged -- which is the stale-arc-state trap the 2026-07-31 interposed session logged: a branch inherits whatever arc-state main carries, and only a phase-START write corrects it. Expect a trivial conflict on this file when #184 lands first; take #184's phase/set_at and this ship's scope. Review round folded three findings into the branch: check-og-images' new crash handler used process.exit(1), which on Windows discards the in-flight stderr write and aborts under libuv (exit 127, not 1) -- rule (1) of the arc-close check-script-conventions candidate; the sitemap sample took the FIRST 2 event URLs, so ordering decided coverage and 63 of 65 events were never checked (widened to 6, and a finished event now WARNS rather than reds, matching the live/slugged scoping principle CI check #47 already documents); and PREFIX_SAMPLE declared 7 page types of which only 3 appear in sitemap.xml. NOT closed by this ship: the arc-close check-search-public-v5 item asked for a rollover-boundary anchor plus a fixed-clock both-direction proof; this branch widens the bound with a measured heuristic instead and says so in its own comment, so the row stays open.
